MUTUAL NONDISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

This Mutual Nondisclosure Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of October 6, 2026 between Larkspur Analytics, Inc., a Delaware corporation ("Larkspur"), and Brightwater Freight Co., an Ohio corporation ("Brightwater"). Each party may disclose ("Discloser") or receive ("Recipient") Confidential Information.

1. Purpose. The parties wish to evaluate a potential route-optimization pilot (the "Purpose").

2. Confidential Information. "Confidential Information" means all information disclosed by Discloser, whether oral, written or electronic, and whether or not marked as confidential, including business plans, pricing, customer lists, software, and technical data.

3. Exclusions. Confidential Information does not include information that (a) is or becomes publicly available through no fault of Recipient; (b) was rightfully known to Recipient without restriction before disclosure; or (c) is rightfully received from a third party without a duty of confidentiality.

4. Obligations. Recipient will use Confidential Information solely for the Purpose and protect it with at least reasonable care. Recipient may disclose Confidential Information to its employees and contractors who need to know it for the Purpose and are bound by written obligations at least as protective as this Agreement.

5. Compelled Disclosure. Recipient may disclose Confidential Information to the extent required by law, provided Recipient gives Discloser prompt written notice where legally permitted.

6. Term. This Agreement remains in effect for five (5) years from the Effective Date. Recipient's obligations survive for seven (7) years after expiration.

7. Return of Materials. Upon Discloser's written request, Recipient will promptly return or destroy all Confidential Information in its possession.

8. Non-Solicitation. During the term and for twelve (12) months thereafter, neither party will directly solicit for employment any employee of the other party with whom it had contact in connection with the Purpose.

9. Remedies. Each party acknowledges that unauthorized disclosure may cause irreparable harm and that Discloser may seek injunctive relief in addition to any other remedies.

10. No License. Nothing in this Agreement grants Recipient any right or license in Discloser's intellectual property.

11. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York, and the parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in New York County.

LARKSPUR ANALYTICS, INC.            BRIGHTWATER FREIGHT CO.
By: ________________                By: ________________
source: pasted text from the Brightwater account executive
